title: Uqrat tan ankacsa abeynit yeemeneh
intro: diini koboxih sabhalal, assakat le kobox ambullee sinni nummak gufe. tukteenay qajiibik tan tutuctot muucumte, oson ken sarrimaane amotani aliftah tan kiryaati ankacisen. ken sumaq raqtem kaxxam baxsa le qibaadah kutbeh addat.
clues: Nanu mango mari able wee numma kinninooh, butta akkuk nemeete.
Nanu cakkumuk tanim naabbe gidih gaaboyna fanah safarne.
nanu gufne wak, nanu cakkumsutak nee cabteh tan kawsi ankacisne.
Nanu nek fanak baali gitat yaniinim kee baali akke waam qaduk oggolleh.
nanu naaxigeh nanu ardi bagul tan qibaadah amri, qaran fanah haadaanam maduudna.
nanu miracsenta noobbe wak, nanu elle naamineh; sinni Rabbil yeemeneh yan num kasaara kee quukak mameysita.
arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
